# semantic-wm attribution

The S-VAE encoder implementation in
`src/fastwam/models/wan22/semantic_svae.py` is adapted from
[`chandar-lab/semantic-wm`](https://github.com/chandar-lab/semantic-wm) at
commit `2fd7618fb5fefa3045f137387a17868688329016`, under the MIT license in
this directory.

The runtime launcher downloads
`Nilaksh404/semantic-wm/vjepa/adapter_vjepa_image_96_multi.pt` at revision
`ba06ced314d61e313ff670b0f932cfecad5126a6`. The model weights are licensed
under CC BY-SA 4.0 and are not distributed in this repository.
